print_pybind11_includes: run the pybind11 CLI with --includes to print include flags for pybind11 and Python headers
print_cmake_dir: run the pybind11 CLI with --cmakedir to print the CMake module directory path
get_include_dir: use get_include to retrieve the pybind11 include directory path for compiler flags
get_cmake_module_dir: use get_cmake_dir to retrieve the CMake module directory for setting -Dpybind11_ROOT
print_help: run the pybind11 CLI with no arguments to print the help message and available options
